goal: converges_to(q, a) = forall(x0: Real) { x0.is_positive implies exists(k0: Nat) { tail_bound(q, a, k0, x0) } }

p.c: function(x0: Nat -> Real, x1: Real) { forall(x2: Real) { not x2.is_positive or exists(k0: Nat) { tail_bound(x0, x1, k0, x2) } } = converges_to(x0, x1) }(q, a)
not forall(x0: Real) { not x0.is_positive or exists(k0: Nat) { tail_bound(q, a, k0, x0) } } or converges_to(q, a)
not forall(x1: Real) { not x1.is_positive or exists(k1: Nat) { tail_bound(q, a, k1, x1) } }
exists(k0: Real) { k0.is_positive and forall(x0: Nat) { not tail_bound(q, a, x0, k0) } }
let w0: Real satisfy { w0.is_positive and forall(x2: Nat) { not tail_bound(q, a, x2, w0) } }
(forall(x0: Nat) { not tail_bound(q, a, x0, w0) } = true)
(forall(x0: Nat) { not tail_bound(q, a, x0, w0) })
function(x0: Nat -> Real, x1: Real) { (exists(k0: Real) { k0.is_positive and forall(x2: Nat) { not tail_bound(x0, x1, x2, k0) } } or converges_to(x0, x1)) = converges_to_intro(x0, x1) }(q, a)
not (forall(x0: Real) { not x0.is_positive or exists(k0: Nat) { tail_bound(q, a, k0, x0) } } and not converges_to(q, a)) or not converges_to_intro(q, a)
not forall(x0: Real) { not x0.is_positive or exists(k0: Nat) { tail_bound(q, a, k0, x0) } } or not converges_to_intro(q, a) or converges_to(q, a)
not converges_to_intro(q, a) or exists(k0: Real) { k0.is_positive and forall(x0: Nat) { not tail_bound(q, a, x0, k0) } } or converges_to(q, a)
(forall(x0: Real) { not x0.is_positive or exists(k0: Nat) { tail_bound(q, a, k0, x0) } } and not converges_to(q, a) or converges_to_intro(q, a))
(forall(x0: Real) { not x0.is_positive or exists(k0: Nat) { tail_bound(q, a, k0, x0) } } = true or converges_to_intro(q, a))
